mainEntity.name: How do we design a suite for an adult child that stays useful in the future?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flexible design ensures the space remains valuable after your adult child transitions to independent housing. Homeowners often design suites that function smoothly as a private guest room, an executive home office, or an accessible in-law suite for aging relatives down the road. Selecting a curbless walk-in shower, wider doorways, and neutral, coordinated cabinetry creates universal appeal. Planning the space with independent lighting zones and ample storage ensures it easily shifts purposes without requiring another major structural remodel later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Incorporate versatile layouts, walk-in showers, ample storage, and independent lighting so the space can later serve as a guest suite, home office, or in-law apartment.
